latestVersion.changelog:
project-factory v0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a four-phase workflow for bootstrapping OpenClaw automation projects: LLM reasoning, flowchart confirmation, node configuration, and full project scaffold generation.
- Supports model selection based on project complexity, defaulting to MiniMax-M2.5 (FAST), with optional upgrade to GPT-4.1 (SMART) for complex flows.
- Automatically parses plain-language project descriptions and synthesizes recommended flowchart and node details.
- User can confirm, edit, or adjust the generated workflow and flowchart before proceeding.
- Guided node-by-node configuration, including skill recommendations and credential checks.
- Ensures outputs (flowcharts, JSON configs) are syntactically valid before progressing.
